name: Brad Antoniewicz
biography: Brad Antoniewicz works in Foundstone's open security research division to uncover flaws in popular technologies. He is a contributing author to both the Hacking Exposed and Hacking Exposed: Wireless series of books and has authored various internal/external Foundstone tools, whitepapers, and methodologies.
